description: antipatterns at rule and group level, markers, examples, case_sensitive, errors

args.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<rules lang="en">
<category id="CAT" name="Category" >
<rule id="R1" name="Rule one"><antipattern><token>x</token><token>foo</token></antipattern><pattern><token>foo</token></pattern><message>Msg</message><example correction="bar"><marker>foo</marker></example></rule>
</category>
</rules>
